meta.title: Every Season — Set 4
meta.subject: English Reading
meta.description: Sentence practice and fill-in-the-blank quiz for 'Every Season'.

questions.question: We taste strawberries and lemonade in _______.
questions.explanation: Strawberries and lemonade are cool, sweet treats that we taste in summer.

questions.question: In autumn, leaves turn and fall.
questions.explanation: Yes, 'Leaves turn and fall' is the correct sentence describing autumn leaves changing colors and dropping.

questions.question: I love spring when grass grows _______.
questions.hint: The color of fresh grass in spring.
questions.explanation: The story begins with: 'I Love Spring when grass grows green.'

questions.question: We wear hats, mittens, scarves, and skates in winter.
questions.explanation: True. The winter section list of clothing is: 'We wear hats, mittens, scarves, and skates.'

questions.question: In spring, we hold rabbits, lambs, kittens, and _______.
questions.explanation: The story mentions holding baby animals in spring: rabbits, lambs, kittens, and chicks.

questions.question: In autumn, wind _______, and seeds scatter.
questions.explanation: The sentence in the story is: 'Wind whips, seeds scatter.'

questions.question: In summer, you can wear a straw hat, or go barefoot in the _______.
questions.explanation: The story says you can 'go barefoot in the grass' in summer.

questions.question: Sort these sentence fragments based on whether they tell about Summer or Winter activities:
questions.explanation: Splash/swim and taste lemonade are summer activities. Coast/slide and make snow angels are winter activities.

questions.question: In the sentence 'Speckled eggs fill woven nests,' the word 'fill' means the nests are empty.
questions.explanation: False. 'Fill' means to make full, so the nests are full of speckled eggs.

questions.question: Arrange the words to show when we pick pumpkins:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'We pick pumpkins in autumn.' Autumn is pumpkin season.

questions.question: When winter comes, snow _______ branches and buds.
questions.explanation: The story says: 'Snow blankets branches and buds' to cover them in winter.

questions.question: Chipmunks store _______ in a secret spot.
questions.hint: The small nuts of an oak tree.
questions.explanation: The sentence is: 'Chipmunks store acorns in a secret spot.'

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe what lilacs do in spring:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'Lilacs spread their sweet smell.' Lilacs are fragrant flowers.

questions.question: In winter, horses grow thick coats, while chickadees search for seeds.
questions.explanation: True. The winter section tells us: 'Horses grow thick coats to keep warm. Chickadees search for seeds.'

questions.question: Spring is the time to dig and plant, and then _______ comes.
questions.explanation: The text says: 'Spring is the time to dig and plant. But then summer comes...'
